2609.32807.title: Beyond Accuracy: Counterfactual Fragility and Demographic Bias in Clinical Evaluation of LLMs
2609.32807.paper_summary: Clinical LLM evaluation often emphasizes answer accuracy; however, accuracy alone does not test counterfactual consistency or demographic robustness. We evaluated six LLMs on 150 MedQA USMLE questions using two automated perturbation tests to assess their performance. The counterfactual validity (CFV) test asked each model to make a minimal, plausible clinical change that would make a different answer correct. The demographic robustness test added six demographic prefixes to the same vignette and compared the answers and explanations with a no demographic baseline. Of the 900 CFV attempts, 228 (25.3 %) were valid and 672 were invalid. Across 5,400 demographic comparisons, 1,097 answers were changed (20.3%). Automated judging identified 3,128 stereotype evidence flags, including 1,932 in the broad Other category. MedGemma 27B achieved the highest accuracy (87.1%) and CFV (63.3%), lowest answer change rate (16.0%), and low mean Explanation Demographic Dissonance (EDD) score (0.169). However, its accuracy still exceeded its CFV, indicating that correct answers do not guarantee reliable performance on the counterfactual validity task. OpenBioLLM had the highest answer change rate and EDD, whereas GLM had the highest stereotype flag rate. These findings show that accuracy, CFV, answer stability, EDD, and stereotype evidence capture different evaluation aspects. Because all judgments were automated and no clinician validation was available, the results support safety screening but do not establish clinical deployability of the model.
2609.32807.paper_summary_zh: 臨床 LLM 評估通常強調答案的準確性；然而，僅僅依賴準確性並不能測試反事實一致性或人口統計穩健性。我們對六個 LLM 在 150 道 MedQA USMLE 問題上的表現進行了評估，使用了兩種自動擾動測試來評估其性能。反事實有效性 (CFV) 測試要求每個模型進行最小的、合理的臨床改變，使得不同的答案變得正確。人口統計穩健性測試則在同一情境中添加了六個人口統計前綴，並將答案和解釋與無人口統計基線進行比較。在 900 次 CFV 嘗試中，有 228 次 (25.3%) 是有效的，672 次是無效的。在 5,400 次人口統計比較中，有 1,097 個答案被改變 (20.3%)。自動判斷識別了 3,128 個刻板印象證據標記，其中 1,932 個屬於廣泛的其他類別。MedGemma 27B 的準確性最高 (87.1%) 和 CFV (63.3%)，答案變更率最低 (16.0%)，且平均解釋人口統計不一致 (EDD) 分數較低 (0.169)。然而，其準確性仍然超過了 CFV，這表明正確答案並不保證在反事實有效性任務上的可靠表現。OpenBioLLM 擁有最高的答案變更率和 EDD，而 GLM 則擁有最高的刻板印象標記率。這些發現顯示準確性、CFV、答案穩定性、EDD 和刻板印象證據捕捉了不同的評估方面。由於所有判斷都是自動化的，且沒有臨床醫生的驗證，結果支持安全篩查，但並未確立模型的臨床可部署性。
